standard: WCAG 2.1 A + AA (wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa)
scope: axe-core covers a well-defined subset of WCAG. It cannot judge whether a label is MEANINGFUL, whether focus order is logical, or whether a live-region announcement is useful. Those remain manual review items and are NOT counted as passes.
